text: The Patriots head into Thursday night's Week 7 showdown against the Bears significantly undermanned up front, with starting left guard Alijah Vera-Tucker officially placed on injured reserve and starting right guard Ben Brown ruled out due to injury—a dual blow that forces offensive line reinforcements in the form of elevated practice squad lineman Xavier Newman-Johnson. The good news comes from the injury report's other end of the spectrum: starting right tackle Morgan Moses, who was listed as questionable, has been cleared to play, which at least provides some continuity on the perimeter, though the loss of Romeo Doubs to a shoulder injury further depletes the receiving corps. The matchup itself carries the narrative weight of two former draft classmates with shared history—Drake Maye and Caleb Williams—meeting on primetime at Soldier Field, while running back Rhamondre Stevenson, who continues to handle the grinding work that doesn't always show up in highlight reels, sits on the cusp of reaching 100 carries for an impressive sixth consecutive season. Thursday Night Football kicks off at 8:15 PM ET, and the oddsmakers and prognosticators will have plenty of angles to dissect as both teams look to build on their respective seasons.
